changelog:
- Persistence: SQLite and searchable history with AI
- Packet capture on risk events with a viewer for everyday users (plain-language flow summary, collapsible per-packet detail, open pcap externally, delete with confirmation)
- AI analysis and summary export for any capture
- Optional blocking of attacker IPs with guaranteed unblock (firewall helper)
- New detection signals: new listeners, outbound fanouts and reputation
- Signed detection signatures (RSA-2048) and embedded Spamhaus DROP feed
- Optional auto-start (off by default)
- Live charts: connections, SYN_SENT, alerts and auth failures
- Language selector (English/Spanish)
- AI improvements: /api/chat prompt, port scans by episodes and RFC 5737 ranges
- Context menu on the table: copy IP, block/unblock
- Option to mute system notifications
- Update checker via version.json
- Full manual in the browser (EN/ES)
